title: Bestiary entry
description: A creature, threat, or generic antagonist that may appear across multiple scenes. Story-forward bestiary entries lean on signature moves rather than full stat blocks.

threatLevel.description: Narrative gauge of how dangerous this is to a typical party. Not a number.

harm.description: Number of harm boxes before this is out of action. 1-2 for a typical mook, 3-4 for a serious threat.

signature.description: What this threat does on its turn in a fight, or how it pressures a scene out of combat. 1-4 entries.

weaknesses.description: Narrative weaknesses that clever PCs can exploit. Not stat penalties.

habitat.description: Where this is encountered. Free text.

loot.description: What might be recovered from this threat. Treated as story prompts, not currency.
